cards.name: ParagraphStyle
cards.path: Text processing commands and classes for Adobe Illustrator/ParagraphStyle
cards.summary: Scripting object for one named paragraph style (an entry of the Paragraph Styles panel). It stores character attributes (font, size, colour, tracking) and paragraph attributes (alignment, indents, spacing) under a name, and applyTo pushes them onto text so every frame it touches gets the same typography.
use_for: consistent headline / body / caption typography across every text frame of a poster, brochure or menu
template automation: style copy dropped into a layout with one applyTo call per frame
restyling a whole document by editing one style instead of every frame
avoid: formatting a few characters inside a paragraph: use a CharacterStyle or the TextRange's characterAttributes
applyTo without clearingOverrides = true on text that already has local formatting: the overrides stay on top and the text does not match the style
cards.how: Reached through the document's collection: app.activeDocument.paragraphStyles (ParagraphStyles). Create one with paragraphStyles.add(name), fetch one with paragraphStyles.getByName(name) or by index. Set its look through the characterAttributes and paragraphAttributes sub-objects, then call style.applyTo(textFrameOrTextRange, true). Over COM it is the same object with PascalCase members (Name, CharacterAttributes, ParagraphAttributes, ApplyTo, Clear, Delete).

key_members.name: name
key_members.use: the style name shown in the Paragraph Styles panel; writable, so a script can rename a style

key_members.name: characterAttributes
key_members.use: character formatting the style carries (textFont, size, fillColor, tracking ...); set its properties

key_members.name: paragraphAttributes
key_members.use: paragraph formatting the style carries (justification, firstLineIndent, spaceBefore, spaceAfter ...); set its properties

key_members.name: applyTo
key_members.use: applyTo(textItem, clearingOverrides=false): apply the style to a text frame, text range or array of them; pass true to drop local overrides

key_members.name: clear
key_members.use: remove every attribute from the style so it defines nothing of its own

key_members.name: remove
key_members.use: delete this style from the document

key_members.name: add
key_members.use: listed on the instance but mirrors the collection; create styles with doc.paragraphStyles.add(name)

key_members.name: removeAll
key_members.use: listed on the instance but mirrors the collection (deletes all elements); avoid on a single style

key_members.name: parent
key_members.use: the owning document

key_members.name: typename
key_members.use: returns "ParagraphStyle"; use to type-check objects from mixed lists

gotchas: applyTo's clearingOverrides defaults to false: local formatting already on the text survives the apply, so the text can look different from the style; pass true for a clean apply.

characterAttributes and paragraphAttributes are read-only references: change the style by setting their properties (style.paragraphAttributes.justification = Justification.CENTER), not by assigning a new object.
characterAttributes.textFont is typed TextFont: assign app.textFonts.getByName("<PostScript name>"), not a font-name string.
The add / removeAll members on the instance mirror the collection; the COM interface has neither (it has Delete instead of remove). Create styles with doc.paragraphStyles.add(name).
paragraphStyles.add(name) with a name that already exists throws; look it up with getByName inside try/catch first (unverified).
The default [Normal Paragraph Style] cannot be removed (unverified).

cards.name: Story
cards.path: Text processing commands and classes for Adobe Illustrator/Story
cards.summary: Scripting object for one flow of text: every character that runs through a chain of threaded (linked) text frames, or the text of a single unthreaded frame. It has no text or formatting of its own; it hands the text out as TextRange views (whole story, paragraphs, lines, words, characters) and lists the frames it flows through.
use_for: reading or restyling the whole article of a multi-column brochure or magazine spread that is threaded across frames
counting characters of a body-copy flow for copy fitting
walking paragraphs in reading order across frames instead of frame by frame
avoid: writing text directly: Story has no contents; use story.textRange.contents
frame layout (position, columns, frame shape): use the TextFrameItem from story.textFrames, or its textPath
cards.how: Reach it from a frame (app.activeDocument.textFrames[i].story) or from the document's list (app.activeDocument.stories). Illustrator makes and dissolves stories as frames are threaded or unthreaded; a script never constructs one. All text work goes through its TextRange views: textRange (the whole story), the paragraphs / lines / words / characters / insertionPoints / textRanges collections, and textFrames for the frames in thread order. COM: Story with Length, TextRange, TextFrames, Paragraphs ...

key_members.name: textRange
key_members.use: the whole story as one TextRange: read/replace contents, format everything at once

key_members.name: textFrames
key_members.use: the frames this story flows through, in thread order

key_members.name: paragraphs
key_members.use: paragraphs of the story (each a TextRange) for per-paragraph styling

key_members.name: lines
key_members.use: composed lines as currently laid out (each a TextRange)

key_members.name: words
key_members.use: words of the story (each a TextRange)

key_members.name: characters
key_members.use: single characters (each a TextRange)

key_members.name: insertionPoints
key_members.use: positions between characters, for inserting text

key_members.name: textRanges
key_members.use: the story's text as a TextRanges collection (harvest: 'All the text in this text range'); how it is split is not documented, so do not assume formatting runs

key_members.name: textSelection
key_members.use: the text the user has selected inside this story

key_members.name: length
key_members.use: number of characters in the story

key_members.name: parent
key_members.use: the containing document

key_members.name: typename
key_members.use: returns "Story"

gotchas: Story has no contents, no attributes and no edit methods of its own: read, write and format through story.textRange or its collections.
Point-text frames cannot be threaded, so each one is a story of its own; only area and path text can form multi-frame stories.
lines reflects the current composition: it changes when frames are resized or fonts change, and overset text that is not displayed may not appear in it (unverified).
textSelection is only filled while the user has text selected with the Type tool; in an unattended run expect it to be empty (unverified).
Looping over characters or words is one DOM call per element and gets slow on long stories; format whole paragraphs or the whole textRange when you can (unverified).

review.changes: textRanges use no longer claims it splits the story into formatting runs (harvest gives no granularity)

cards.name: TextPath
cards.path: Text processing commands and classes for Adobe Illustrator/TextPath
cards.summary: The path a text frame lives on: the shape that holds area text, or the line that path (on-path) text runs along; point text has none. It carries the path geometry (pathPoints, setEntirePath, position, width, height) and its own fill, stroke, opacity and blend mode, so a script can colour or outline the text box shape separately from the letters.
use_for: give an area-text box a background fill or border (callout, label panel, price tag) without drawing a separate rectangle
reshape the line a headline follows on a badge, seal or curved banner
read the text box's bounds or area for copy-fit and layout checks
avoid: colouring the letters: set textRange.characterAttributes.fillColor; textPath.fillColor paints the frame shape
point text: it has no text path; convert with textFrame.convertPointObjectToAreaObject() or build area text from a PathItem with textFrames.areaText(path)

duplicating, deleting or transforming the text object: TextPath has no duplicate / remove / transform; act on the owning TextFrameItem (position / top / left on the path are writable, but move the frame, not its path)
cards.how: Read-only property of a text frame: app.activeDocument.textFrames[i].textPath, defined for frames whose kind is TextType.AREATEXT or TextType.PATHTEXT. A script does not create one directly: it draws a PathItem and passes it to textFrames.areaText(path) or textFrames.pathText(path, ...), which turns that path into the frame's text path. Geometry is then edited with setEntirePath / pathPoints, appearance with filled, fillColor, stroked, strokeColor, strokeWidth, opacity and blendingMode. COM: TextFrame.TextPath with PascalCase members (SetEntirePath, FillColor ...).

key_members.name: pathPoints
key_members.use: the anchor points of the frame shape / text line

key_members.name: setEntirePath
key_members.use: replace the whole path from an array of [x, y] anchor points; the text reflows into the new shape

key_members.name: filled
key_members.use: turn on a fill for the frame shape (background panel behind area text)

key_members.name: fillColor
key_members.use: colour of that frame fill (not the glyph colour)

key_members.name: stroked
key_members.use: turn on an outline for the frame shape or the text line

key_members.name: strokeColor
key_members.use: outline colour of the frame shape

key_members.name: strokeWidth
key_members.use: outline weight in points

key_members.name: strokeDashes
key_members.use: dash lengths for a dashed frame border; empty for solid

key_members.name: opacity
key_members.use: opacity of the path appearance, 0.0-100.0

key_members.name: blendingMode
key_members.use: BlendModes value used when compositing the path

key_members.name: position
key_members.use: top-left corner of the text path

key_members.name: width
key_members.use: width of the text path (harvest range 0-16348)

key_members.name: height
key_members.use: height of the text path (harvest range 0-16348)

key_members.name: top
key_members.use: top edge position

key_members.name: left
key_members.use: left edge position

key_members.name: closed
key_members.use: whether the path is closed (area shapes) or open (a text line)

key_members.name: area
key_members.use: area of the path in square points (read-only)

key_members.name: editable
key_members.use: read-only flag: can this text path be modified

key_members.name: clipping
key_members.use: use the path as a clipping path

key_members.name: note
key_members.use: free-text note stored on the path

gotchas: Point text (TextType.POINTTEXT) has no text path (the harvest describes textPath as 'area and path text'): check textFrame.kind before touching textPath.
fillColor / strokeColor style the frame shape, not the glyphs: an area-text box with filled = true shows a coloured panel behind the text.
strokeMiterLimit's harvested description ('whether a join is mitered ...') is the wrong text: the member is a number, the miter-limit ratio.
strokeDashes: the harvest says 'set to {}' (AppleScript spelling); in ExtendScript pass an empty array [] for a solid line (unverified).
Unlike PathItem it has no transform, move, duplicate or remove members: transform the TextFrameItem instead.
Reshaping on-path text with setEntirePath can move where the text starts and ends; the frame's startTValue / endTValue may need resetting (unverified).

review.changes: avoid no longer says the path cannot be moved (position/top/left are writable in the harvest); added harvested 0-16348 range to width/height

cards.name: TextRange
cards.path: Text processing commands and classes for Adobe Illustrator/TextRange
cards.summary: The workhorse of Illustrator text scripting: a run of characters inside a story (a whole frame's text, one paragraph, word or character, or any offset/length slice). Through it a script reads or replaces the string (contents) and formats just that run via characterAttributes and paragraphAttributes.
use_for: writing headline and body copy into template text frames
highlighting a price, date or keyword in another size or colour inside a sentence
ALL-CAPS headlines (changeCaseTo) and per-word / per-letter styling for typographic posters
applying character or paragraph styles to part of the text
avoid: frame layout (position, columns, box shape): use the TextFrameItem or its TextPath
per-character loops over long copy: slow; format whole words, paragraphs or one sliced range instead
reusing ranges fetched before a contents edit: fetch them again after inserting or deleting text
cards.how: Get one from any text container: textFrame.textRange (whole frame), story.textRange (whole threaded story), or any element of the characters / words / lines / paragraphs / textRanges / insertionPoints collections (each element is itself a TextRange). Read or replace the text with contents; format with characterAttributes (textFont, size, fillColor, tracking ...) and paragraphAttributes (justification, indents, spacing); narrow it by setting characterOffset and length (or start / end). To apply a named style call characterStyle.applyTo(range) or paragraphStyle.applyTo(range). COM: TextRange with PascalCase members, Delete instead of remove.

key_members.name: contents
key_members.use: the text string of the range; assign to replace it

key_members.name: characterAttributes
key_members.use: character formatting of this run: textFont, size, fillColor, strokeColor, tracking, baselineShift ...

key_members.name: paragraphAttributes
key_members.use: paragraph formatting of the paragraphs the range touches: justification, indents, spaceBefore/After ...

key_members.name: characters
key_members.use: the single characters in the range (each a TextRange)

key_members.name: words
key_members.use: the words in the range (each a TextRange)

key_members.name: lines
key_members.use: the composed lines in the range

key_members.name: paragraphs
key_members.use: the paragraphs in the range

key_members.name: textRanges
key_members.use: the range's text as a TextRanges collection; how it is split is not documented, so do not assume formatting runs (use getTextRunLength for the first run)

key_members.name: insertionPoints
key_members.use: positions between characters, for inserting text

key_members.name: characterOffset
key_members.use: offset of the first character from the start of the story; settable to slide the range

key_members.name: length
key_members.use: number of characters in the range; settable to grow or shrink it

key_members.name: start
key_members.use: start index of the range

key_members.name: end
key_members.use: end index of the range

key_members.name: kerning
key_members.use: pair kerning in milli-ems (thousandths of an em)

key_members.name: story
key_members.use: the story this range belongs to

key_members.name: paragraphStyles
key_members.use: paragraph styles already used in the range (read-only list)

key_members.name: characterStyles
key_members.use: character styles already used in the range (read-only list)

key_members.name: changeCaseTo
key_members.use: changeCaseTo(CaseChangeType.UPPERCASE / LOWERCASE / TITLECASE / SENTENCECASE)

key_members.name: getTextRunLength
key_members.use: length of the first run of uniformly formatted text in the range

key_members.name: remove
key_members.use: delete the characters of the range

gotchas: characterAttributes / paragraphAttributes are read-only references: set their properties (range.characterAttributes.size = 48), never assign a new object.
paragraphAttributes always act on whole paragraphs, even when the range covers only part of one.
characterStyles / paragraphStyles only list styles already used in the range; to apply a style call style.applyTo(range).
Assigning contents replaces the run; the new text takes the formatting of the first character that was replaced (unverified).
Ranges are not live anchors: after inserting or deleting text, ranges fetched earlier can point at the wrong characters; fetch them again (unverified).
Taking characters[n] and then setting its length is the usual way to slice an arbitrary sub-range (common idiom, unverified in 30.2).
Each characters[i] / words[i] access is a separate DOM call; loops over thousands of characters are very slow (unverified).
select() / deSelect() change the user's selection and need the document active; avoid them in unattended runs (unverified).

review.changes: textRanges use no longer claims formatting runs (harvest gives no granularity)

cards.name: TracingObject
cards.summary: The live Image Trace result attached to a traced raster: the script handle on Illustrator's Image Tracing plugin group. It reports the trace's path, anchor and colour counts and turns the trace into real editable vector paths (expandTracing) or discards it and gives back the source image (releaseTracing).
use_for: converting a raster logo, sketch, stamp or scanned signature into editable vector paths
batch-vectorising icons or line art for print, vinyl or laser cutting
checking trace complexity (anchors, paths, colours) before expanding, e.g. to reject an over-detailed result
avoid: photographs that must keep their photo look: tracing posterises into flat colour shapes; keep the raster
changing trace settings here: they live in tracingOptions (see TracingOptions)
cards.how: Created by tracing a raster: app.activeDocument.rasterItems[i].trace() (or placedItems[i].trace()) returns a PluginItem whose isTracing is true and whose tracing property is this TracingObject. Adjust tracing.tracingOptions, let the trace recompute, read pathCount / anchorCount / usedColorCount, then call expandTracing() for a GroupItem of paths or releaseTracing() to get the source art back. COM: PluginItem.Tracing -> TracingObject with ExpandTracing / ReleaseTracing.

key_members.name: tracingOptions
key_members.use: the TracingOptions driving this trace; set its properties to re-trace

key_members.name: sourceArt
key_members.use: the raster/placed art the trace was made from

key_members.name: pathCount
key_members.use: number of paths in the current trace result

key_members.name: anchorCount
key_members.use: number of anchor points in the result; a complexity check before expanding

key_members.name: usedColorCount
key_members.use: number of colours the result uses

key_members.name: expandTracing
key_members.use: expandTracing(viewed=false): convert the trace to a GroupItem of paths; deletes this tracing object

key_members.name: releaseTracing
key_members.use: drop the trace and return the source art as a PageItem; deletes this tracing object

key_members.name: parent
key_members.use: the PluginItem that holds the trace

key_members.name: typename
key_members.use: returns "TracingObject"

gotchas: trace() always starts with default options (harvest: 'using default options'); set tracingOptions afterwards (that the trace then re-runs is unverified).

trace() moves the raster into the new trace (harvest: 'Reorders this raster to the source art'): afterwards reach the image through tracing.sourceArt, not its old rasterItems / placedItems index (unverified detail).

expandTracing and releaseTracing delete this tracing object (harvest): references to it are dead afterwards, and the PluginItem is likely gone too (unverified); keep the returned GroupItem / PageItem.
Call app.redraw() after trace() or option changes before reading the counts or expanding, or you can get a stale or empty result (widely reported, unverified).
expandTracing(true) expands what the current viewMode shows rather than the plain tracing result (unverified).
Large high-resolution images block the script for a long time inside trace(); downsample first and wrap the call in a timeout (unverified).
A PlacedItem that is not a raster (linked PDF / AI / EPS) cannot be traced (unverified).

review.changes: trace() 'reorders' gotcha rewritten: the raster becomes the trace's sourceArt, not a stacking-order change; re-run after option change and dead PluginItem marked unverified

cards.name: TracingOptions
cards.summary: The settings of one Image Trace, the same controls as the Image Trace panel: mode (colour / grey / black-and-white), limited colours or full-colour fidelity, threshold, grey levels, path / corner / noise fidelity, fills vs strokes, abutting vs overlapping method, ignore white, plus loading and saving named presets. Changing them re-traces the linked TracingObject.
use_for: clean black-and-white logo, stamp or signature vectorisation (black-and-white mode, threshold, ignore white)
limited-palette traces for screen-print style posters and illustrations (limited colours, tracingColors)
repeatable house trace settings saved as a named preset for batch runs
avoid: setting options before a trace exists: there is no standalone TracingOptions; trace first, then edit pi.tracing.tracingOptions
photo-real output: even high colour fidelity gives flat shapes; keep the raster
cards.how: Reached through a trace: app.activeDocument.rasterItems[i].trace().tracing.tracingOptions (or placedItems[i]). Either loadFromPreset(name) with a name from app.tracingPresetsList, or set properties one by one using the TracingModeType, TracingColorType, TracingMethodType and ViewType enums; save the combination with storeToPreset(name). preset reports the active preset name. COM: TracingObject.TracingOptions with PascalCase members (TracingMode, Threshold, LoadFromPreset ...).

key_members.name: tracingMode
key_members.use: TracingModeType.TRACINGMODECOLOR / TRACINGMODEGRAY / TRACINGMODEBLACKANDWHITE

key_members.name: tracingColorTypeValue
key_members.use: TracingColorType.TRACINGLIMITEDCOLOR (uses tracingColors) or TRACINGFULLCOLOR (uses colorFidelity)

key_members.name: tracingColors
key_members.use: maximum number of colours in limited-colour mode

key_members.name: colorFidelity
key_members.use: colour fidelity in full-colour mode

key_members.name: threshold
key_members.use: black/white cut-off for black-and-white mode; 1-256 (harvest)

key_members.name: grayLevels
key_members.use: number of grey levels for greyscale mode; 1-256 (harvest)

key_members.name: pathFidelity
key_members.use: how closely paths follow the pixels (higher = more anchors)

key_members.name: cornerFidelity
key_members.use: how readily corners are kept sharp instead of rounded

key_members.name: noiseFidelity
key_members.use: minimum pixel area that becomes a path; raise to drop specks

key_members.name: tracingMethod
key_members.use: TracingMethodType.TRACINGMETHODABUTTING (cut-out shapes) or TRACINGMETHODOVERLAPPING (stacked shapes)

key_members.name: fills
key_members.use: produce filled shapes

key_members.name: strokes
key_members.use: produce stroked paths (line art)

key_members.name: maxStrokeWeight
key_members.use: widest feature traced as a stroke when strokes are on

key_members.name: ignoreWhite
key_members.use: drop white areas from the result (abutting method, black-and-white mode only)

key_members.name: snapCurveToLines
key_members.use: snap slightly curved segments to straight lines

key_members.name: autoGrouping
key_members.use: group the resulting paths automatically

key_members.name: palette
key_members.use: colour library name used for tracing, e.g. 'Document Library'

key_members.name: viewMode
key_members.use: ViewType: how the trace is displayed (result, outlines, source image ...)

key_members.name: loadFromPreset
key_members.use: loadFromPreset(presetName): load a whole preset; returns bool

key_members.name: storeToPreset
key_members.use: storeToPreset(presetName): save current options as a preset; overwrites an unlocked preset of the same name

gotchas: ignoreWhite only works with tracingMethod = TRACINGMETHODABUTTING and black-and-white mode (harvested description).
fills and strokes cannot both be off (harvest: 'Fills, Strokes or both must be on').
tracingColors only counts with TRACINGLIMITEDCOLOR and colorFidelity only with TRACINGFULLCOLOR (harvested descriptions); setting the other one has no visible effect.
preset is read-only: switch presets with loadFromPreset, using a name exactly as listed in app.tracingPresetsList.
storeToPreset silently overwrites an existing unlocked preset with the same name (harvest).
threshold only applies to black-and-white mode and grayLevels only to greyscale mode (harvested descriptions); both take 1-256.

The harvest gives ranges only for threshold and grayLevels (1-256); ranges of tracingColors, colorFidelity, pathFidelity, cornerFidelity, noiseFidelity and maxStrokeWeight are not in it, and out-of-range values may be clamped or throw (unverified).
Every property change re-runs the trace; on big images set everything, then app.redraw() once before expanding (unverified).

review.changes: gotcha claimed numeric ranges are absent from the harvest: threshold and grayLevels are 1-256 there; added those ranges to key_members and gotchas, threshold/grayLevels mode note now cites the harvest instead of 'unverified'

cards.name: Matrix
cards.path: Transformation matrix events and classes for Adobe Illustrator/Matrix
cards.summary: A 2D affine transformation matrix value: mValueA-D hold scale, rotation and skew, mValueTX / mValueTY the translation in points. Scripts build one with the app.get...Matrix / app.concatenate...Matrix functions and apply it with pageItem.transform(); text frames also expose their current one as textFrame.matrix.
use_for: rotate + scale + move artwork in one step for pattern, badge or layout automation
reading a text frame's rotation or scale so it can be copied to other elements
exact skews (shear), which rotate() and resize() cannot express
avoid: a single plain move, rotation or scale: call translate(), rotate() or resize() on the PageItem
editing a matrix and expecting the art to follow: the matrix is a detached value until passed to transform()
cards.how: Get one from the Application: app.getIdentityMatrix(), app.getRotationMatrix(angle), app.getScaleMatrix(scaleX, scaleY), app.getTranslationMatrix(deltaX, deltaY); combine with app.concatenateMatrix / concatenateRotationMatrix / concatenateScaleMatrix / concatenateTranslationMatrix; invert with app.invertMatrix; test with app.isEqualMatrix / isSingularMatrix. Apply with pageItem.transform(matrix, changePositions, changeFillPatterns, changeFillGradients, changeStrokePattern, changeLineWidths, transformAbout). The six fields can also be read or set directly. COM: _Matrix with MValueA ... MValueTY; the Matrix coclass is creatable (harvest flag cancreate).

key_members.name: mValueA
key_members.use: horizontal scale / cosine component of rotation

key_members.name: mValueB
key_members.use: rotation / vertical skew component; Math.atan2(mValueB, mValueA) gives the rotation angle

key_members.name: mValueC
key_members.use: rotation / horizontal skew component

key_members.name: mValueD
key_members.use: vertical scale / cosine component of rotation

key_members.name: mValueTX
key_members.use: horizontal translation in points

key_members.name: mValueTY
key_members.use: vertical translation in points

gotchas: A Matrix is a value: changing its fields or concatenating does nothing to artwork until it is passed to pageItem.transform().
The concatenate functions return a new matrix: assign the result (m = app.concatenateScaleMatrix(m, 120, 120)).
Order matters: rotate-then-translate is not the same as translate-then-rotate.
Scale values are percentages (harvested defaults are 100.0 = unchanged), not factors.

transform() defaults to transformAbout = Transformation.CENTER (harvest), so the matrix is applied about the item's centre, not the document origin; changeLineWidths (default 100) controls stroke-weight scaling.
textFrame.matrix is read-only: read it to recover a frame's rotation, change it with transform().
The harvest marks the six mValue members as class scope; treat them as fields of the matrix object you hold (unverified).
Angles are in degrees with positive = counter-clockwise, and the scripting y axis points up, so signs of mValueB / mValueC are the reverse of screen-down systems (unverified).

review.changes: use_for no longer says mirror flips need a matrix (resize with a negative scale mirrors); how notes the creatable COM Matrix coclass
